title: Beetle God on Cosmic Mound
description: A large white line-art beetle deity with multiple arms, antlers, and ornate patterns sits atop a textured black mound. Below, a vibrant explosion of multicolored circles, rings, and small insects spreads across the bottom, while white line-drawn human figures worship on either side against a solid black background.
prompt: Surreal symbolic illustration featuring a large multi-armed beetle god with antlers and ornate golden patterns, sitting atop a textured black mound. White line-drawn human worshippers kneel on both sides. Bottom half explodes with vibrant overlapping colorful circles, rings, and tiny beetles on a black background. High contrast, mystical atmosphere, detailed linework mixed with bold flat color elements.
